verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's passkey docs say users can save passkeys in the vault and autofill them through the browser extension and mobile apps across websites and apps, so it goes beyond TOTP codes. Its llms.txt also positions it as a manager for passkeys. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of passkey sign-in flows and platform coverage (e.g., OS-level passkey provider support), and independent or hands-on corroboration that passkey sign-in works in practice.
